en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall steel railway viaduct spanning a forested valley with rocky slopes. Coniferous trees cover the hillsides and a small wooden hut stands in the foreground on open ground. The scene has an early-20th-century printed look. At the top in red Gothic-style lettering it reads "Bahnviadukt bei Grünhain." There is an additional small handwritten note next to the printed title.
